data.narrative:
Tobe Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Colby DeWeese and Caleb Lareau that has raised $4.6M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—none of the narrow filters yielded three or more datapoints—making traditional peer-median valuation unreliable at this stage.

The analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions. Using total capital raised of $4.6M as a proxy base value of $5M, the stage-progression method implies a post-money valuation of $12M. This approach anchors valuation to observable capital deployment while accounting for typical investor return expectations at the Seed-to-Series A inflection.

The triangulated valuation range is $10M–$13M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects uncertainty inherent in single-method reliance and the absence of direct peer benchmarking. Key uncertainties include the company's underlying unit economics, market traction, and capital efficiency relative to sector peers—data not available in this dataset. Investors should stress-test this range against revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and competitive positioning before finalizing terms.
